The planner said that Joseph was born later because his birth year is 1957, but Viktoriya was born in 1998, which is later. Wait, no, 1998 is after 1957, so Viktoriya was born later. But the initial answer said Joseph was born later, which is wrong.

Looking back, the WebSurfer correctly found both birth years. So the mistake wasn't in the WebSurfer's search but in the Planner's analysis when they concluded that Joseph was born later. So the error was in the Planner's step, step 3, where they compared the years incorrectly. They thought 1957 is later, but actually, 1998 is later.
